scientific_integrity: An all-length elementary factor classification and exact lattice-count proof underpin the claims. Finite exhaustive checks independently corroborate small and boundary cases; no numerical check is represented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite linear binary words with exactly two marked symbols; exceptional word 11 treated separately. No independent audit. An inaccessible 2014 primary full text creates residual historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Exact Abelian-unbordered factor spectrum of binary words with two marked symbols
